name: Project WAND: Festival of Futas
source:
The great Festival of Futas has arrived in the realm of witchdom. You play as Savaasa, a well-endowed "Wandkin" competing in the Festival challenge to reach the top and claim victory for all of futa-kind!

In short, you're a futanari witch competing in the yearly futa witch tournament. And along the way you'll rail your fellow contestants - some may be futas and some may be just your regular ol' dickless girl.
translation:
伟大的弗塔斯节已经来到了巫术领域。你扮演Savaasa，一位天赋异禀的“Wandkin”，参加节日挑战赛，登上顶峰，为所有futa类的人赢得胜利！

简而言之，你是一名futanari女巫，参加一年一度的futa女巫锦标赛。一路上你会抱怨你的参赛者同伴——有些可能是futas，有些可能只是普通的无鸡鸡女孩。
